notes: Status reflects whether the feature is wired end-to-end into the live paper pipeline (src/index.ts evaluate + loop), not just whether the module exists.
'unknown' = the module is wired but we have no real-world evidence yet.
'failing' = the module exists with passing unit tests, but is NOT wired into evaluate() so its score never reaches the master signal.
Current commit baseline: e8b784c (local, 1 ahead of origin).
Test baseline: 75/75 vitest passing; pnpm typecheck clean.
